# Overlap

> Overlap is a free, open-source group scheduling poll at https://overlap.redleg.dev. An organizer picks dates (or days of the week) and a range of hours, shares one link, and each person drags across a grid to mark when they're free. Overlap shows a group heatmap and ranks the time windows the most people can make. No accounts, no ads, no cookies. Built and hosted by Red Leg Dev (https://redleg.dev).

## Key facts

- Price: free. No paid tiers.
- Accounts: none, for organizers or respondents. Respondents type a name; the device remembers them; a personal edit link moves them to another device.
- Availability marking: drag-to-paint on desktop and phones, with "Available" and "If needed" brushes.
- Time zones: each viewer sees the grid in their own time zone; the organizer's zone is one tap away.
- Results: ranked "Best times" windows with counts and the names of who's missing, plus a "Must attend" filter.
- Finalizing: the organizer locks in a time; everyone gets an .ics file or a Google Calendar link.
- Organizer email: optional at creation; Overlap sends the poll and organizer links once and does not store the address.
- Analytics: cookie-free, self-hosted Plausible page counts with poll ids and links redacted. No ad tracking.
- Privacy: polls are reachable only by link and excluded from search engines. Date polls are deleted 60 days after their last date.
- Source: MIT license, https://github.com/RedLegDev/overlap. Runs on Cloudflare Workers with a D1 database.

## Pages

- [Create a poll](https://overlap.redleg.dev/): home page with the poll creation form and FAQ.
